title: Assistant Designer Intern, Studio Création (Stage)
note: High-jewelry design studio internship in Paris starting 3 Jan 2027; posting is in French and a portfolio is mandatory.

facts.summary: Full-time internship in Chaumet's Design & Creation studio at Place Vendôme, under a senior designer.
facts.duties: Illustrator vector tracings at full scale, gouache and marker renderings, scanning and retouching renderings, research sketches, Photoshop mockups, CAD volumes and presentation visuals.
facts.requirements: Art-school student; eye for aesthetics and 3D volume; Photoshop and Illustrator; 3D software and InDesign are a plus.
facts.apply: Apply via the LVMH careers page with a portfolio.
